Name: Find Item
Author: ogahalo00
Description:
[size=6][b]🌟 Find Item - Smart Inventory Search & Pathfinding Tool[/b][/size]
[i]Effortlessly locate any item across all your inventories, chests, fridges, buildings, and Item Bags in Stardew Valley 1.6+.[/i]

[line]

[size=4][b]📖 Overview[/b][/size]
Ever lost track of where you put that rare ancient seed, tool, or stack of hardwood? With dozens of chests and sheds across your farm, searching manually is a thing of the past!
[b]Find Item[/b] is a modern, lightweight quality-of-life mod designed to help you instantly search and pinpoint the exact location of any item you own, complete with an in-game highlighted guidance path leading straight to the target container.

Inspired by classic mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27409]Item Locator[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2086]Where’s My Items[/url], this mod offers a clean, lightning-fast, and distraction-free experience.

[line]

[size=4][b]✨ What's New in v1.2.0[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]⚡ Auto-Focus Search Bar:[/b] Press your search hotkey and start typing immediately — no need to click into the text box first![/*]
[*][b]🎒 Item Bags Mod Compatibility:[/b] Fully integrated with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5382]Item Bags[/url]! Mod can now search inside Bounded Bags, Bundle Bags, Rucksacks, and even nested bags inside OmniBags.[/*]
[*][b]⌨️ Full Keyboard Navigation:[/b] Navigate search results with [b]Up / Down[/b] arrow keys, jump with [b]PageUp / PageDown[/b], and press [b]Enter[/b] to inspect.[/*]
[*][b]❌ Quick Clear Button:[/b] Added a one-click 'X' button to instantly clear your search query.[/*]
[*][b]🌐 Native i18n Multi-language Support:[/b] Full localization support (English & Vietnamese included out of the box).[/*]
[*][b]🧭 Smarter Pathfinding:[/b] Paths now reliably reach solid containers (chests, fridges) and automatically clear via a configurable timer.[/*]
[*][b]🎨 Polished UI & Crisp Typography:[/b] Redesigned text layout with pixel-perfect font scaling, vertical centering, and clean item counts.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b]🔍 Core Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Comprehensive Storage Search:[/b]
 
[list]
 [*] Player Inventory & Backpack
  [/*]
[*]Standard & Stone/Big Chests everywhere in the world
  [/*]
[*]Kitchen Fridges & Mini-Fridges (Farmhouse & Island Farmhouse)
  [/*]
[*]Auto-Grabbers (in Barns & Coops)
  [/*]
[*]Farm buildings (Barns, Coops, Sheds, Mills, Cabins)
  [/*]
[*]Other players' cabins in Multiplayer
  [/*]
[*]Modded containers & Item Bags
  [/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]🧭 Visual Guidance Path:[/b] Draws a highlighted tile trail on the ground showing the shortest path directly from your player to the target chest or fridge.[/*]
[*][b]📊 Detailed Item Inspector:[/b] Shows total count owned, exact breakdown by quality (Normal, Silver, Gold, Iridium), and every container name/location.[/*]
[*][b]⚙️ Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) Support:[/b] Configure all hotkeys and settings in-game via GMCM without editing JSON files.[/*]
[*][b]🎮 Controller & Keyboard Friendly:[/b] Smooth scrolling, auto-focus, and full key bindings.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b]🎮 Default Controls & Hotkeys[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]F2[/b] ([c]SearchKey[/c]): Open the item search menu.[/*]
[*][b]D[/b] ([c]QuickSearchKey[/c]): In the item detail menu, quickly trigger visual pathfinding to the item.[/*]
[*][b]H[/b] ([c]HidePathKey[/c]): Instantly hide the active visual path.[/*]
[*][b]None[/b] ([c]ToggleKey[/c]): Toggle mod enabled/disabled status.[/*]
[*][b]Up / Down / Enter[/b]: Navigate and select search results using keyboard.[/*]
[*][b]Esc / Menu Button[/b]: Close the menu.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b]⚙️ Configuration[/b][/size]
You can configure the mod directly in-game using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url], or edit [c]Mods/Find_Item/config.json[/c]:

[code]
{
  "ToggleKey": "None",
  "SearchKey": "F2",
  "QuickSearchKey": "D",
  "HidePathKey": "H",
  "ModEnabled": true,
  "AutoHidePaths": true,
  "AutoHideDelay": 60
}[/code]
[line]

[size=4][b]📥 Installation[/b][/size]
[olist]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (4.0+ recommended).[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the [c]Find_Item[/c] folder into your [c]Stardew Valley/Mods[/c] directory.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI and enjoy!
[/olist]

[line]

[size=4][b]🌐 Localization / Translations[/b][/size]
Find Item supports native SMAPI i18n translations.
Currently supported languages:
[list]
[*] English ([c]default.json[/c])[/*]
[*]Vietnamese / Tiếng Việt ([c]vi.json[/c])[/*]
[*]Chinese / 简体中文 ([c]zh.json[/c]) - [i]thanks to tiehu![/i][/*]
[/list][i]Want to translate Find Item into your language? Feel free to submit a pull request or share your translation file on [url=https://github.com/QuangBM138/Find-Item]GitHub[/url]![/i]
